question: Qual gênero tem a maior margem média de lucro?
sql_attempts: WITH genre_stats AS (SELECT g.sk_genre_id, g.nome_genero, COUNT(DISTINCT m.sk_movie_id) AS filmes_validos, AVG(1.0 * (p.receita_brl - p.orcamento_brl) / p.receita_brl) AS margem_media FROM dim_genres AS g JOIN bridge_movie_genre AS bg ON g.sk_genre_id = bg.sk_genre_id JOIN dim_movies AS m ON bg.sk_movie_id = m.sk_movie_id JOIN fact_movies_performance AS p ON m.sk_movie_id = p.sk_movie_id WHERE p.receita_brl > 0 AND NOT p.orcamento_brl IS NULL GROUP BY g.sk_genre_id, g.nome_genero) SELECT sk_genre_id, nome_genero, filmes_validos, margem_media FROM genre_stats WHERE margem_media = (SELECT MAX(margem_media) FROM genre_stats) LIMIT 100
